name: scan-planner-reproduction
title: Integrate SCAN-Planner Foxy with Lite3 Physics Simulation
description: Port the pinned SCAN ROS 2 planner core to Foxy and validate a versioned TCP closed loop against a pinned Lite3 Isaac policy simulation on the 5070 Ti.
creator: sun
notes: V3 uses the pinned sensor-rig URDF with V12 model_149999 plus live MID-360-like and D435i-like simulated sensors. Asset, locomotion A/B, dual-sensor, two-dry-run, frozen closed-loop, sync, and local re-evaluation gates passed 71/71. Human review remains required; V2 is baseline-only. On 2026-08-14 Dr Sun approved a bounded V4 forest locomotion preview using the same URDF and checkpoint. V4 preview02 passed automated identity, deterministic terrain, visible/collision/dual-sensor geometry, locomotion, video, sync, and hash gates; Dr Sun's visual review remains pending. V3 evidence stays immutable and SCAN forest closed-loop remains out of scope.
